summary: Preserved PR 972's valid GLM-5.3 processor fixes and corrected its reproduced adjacent-placeholder cardinality loss by using the number of supplied image items during token normalization. This does not verify or explain the original model-level Statue of Liberty-to-bird semantics.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: two adjacent pretokenized image placeholders with two image_data items were reduced to one before load_mm_data.

Passing-after: 11 tests covered the reproduced two-image boundary, single and separated expanded spans, no placeholder invention, non-GLM behavior, registration, synthetic JPEG data-URL preprocessing, and resize boundaries.
Fourteen GLM multimodal processor tests passed, including neighboring image/video shared-token offset behavior.
The consolidated patch has no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution_evidence: ROCm inventory found one AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950. No model inference ran; this cannot substitute for private GLM-5.3 weights on the reported 8x NVIDIA H20 deployment.
remaining_limitations: The exact Statue of Liberty JPEG, private GLM-5.3-Flash-sglang0907-128k-0907t3 weights, reported 0907 serving image, eight NVIDIA H20 GPUs, CUDA runtime, and original deployment were unavailable. Therefore no exact OpenAI-compatible endpoint request or landmark-semantic check was possible, and the already-visual bird response remains unexplained. The correction is limited to the independently reproduced placeholder-cardinality defect.
